candidate_method: Unchanged Phase 10B1 personal_backfilled, exactly 100; canonical hashes must match Phase 10B2A
feature_history: Previous calendar month, inclusive start and exclusive prediction timestamp, UTC; exact-row-deduplicated events; all four event types retained for recency/activity
missing_feature_policy: Unseen user-product: zero event counts, NaN recency, source flag 0; missing buyer count 0. No fitted imputation/scaling.

training_sampling.method: SHA256 of growthlab-10b2b:seed:user:product; first unsigned 64 bits < floor(2^64/50); independent rowwise training-only negative sampling
training_sampling.sample_weight: 1 for retained positives, 50 for retained negatives; inverse inclusion weighting approximates full candidate-pair log loss, not equal-user ranking loss

score: decision_function margin; not a validated calibrated purchase probability
ml_ties: Descending margin, then frozen personalized-recency position, then product ID; no score rounding
evaluation: All validation customers and all 100 candidates; frozen Recall/NDCG definitions at K=5,10,20; primary macro Recall@10 and macro NDCG@10; micro recall separately

uncertainty.method: Paired purchaser-level percentile bootstrap of ML minus recency metric differences; same sampled user indices for all six endpoints
uncertainty.limitations: Pointwise intervals conditional on fitted model, this cohort, fixed retrieval and sampling; no training-refit, temporal or shared-product uncertainty; secondary endpoints exploratory, no simultaneous correction

selection: Prefer ML only if both primary validation differences have 95% paired lower bounds above zero; otherwise retain recency. No business-value threshold supplied; do not invent one.
scope: One prespecified model fit, no hyperparameter search, no final-test labels, no change to candidates or earlier modules
